e: The correct answer is Public Private Partnership. PPP stands for Public Private Partnership — a long-term arrangement where the government partners with a private entity to finance, build and operate infrastructure, sharing risks and rewards. On Railways, PPP is used for projects like station redevelopment, private freight terminals and port connectivity. Related fact: PPP projects are typically structured through a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) under a Model Concession Agreement (MCA).

q: MCA stands for ? (in context of PPP)
e: Option A is correct: in the PPP context, MCA stands for Model Concession Agreement — the standardised contract framework under which a private concessionaire is granted the right to build and operate a project for a fixed concession period. Approach by elimination: strike out the options that contradict the basic principle, and the survivor is your answer. Building this elimination habit speeds up the paper considerably.

The correct answer is Viability Gap Fund. VGF stands for Viability Gap Fund (Viability Gap Finance) — government support given to PPP projects that are economically desirable but not financially viable on their own, bridging the gap between project cost and affordable user charges. Related fact: VGF is typically extended as a capital grant during construction to make the project bankable for the private concessionaire.

Option A (Special Purpose Vehicle) is the correct choice. SPV stands for Special Purpose Vehicle — a separate legal entity created solely to implement a PPP project, ring-fencing its finances, assets and liabilities from the parent organisations. Related fact: the SPV signs the Model Concession Agreement (MCA) with the public authority and raises project finance on the strength of the project's cash flows.

Option C (Built, Own, Operate & Transfer) is the correct choice. BOOT stands for Build, Own, Operate and Transfer — the private party builds the facility, owns and operates it during the concession period to recover its investment, and transfers it back to the government at the end. Related fact: BOOT is one of the standard PPP models alongside BOT (Build-Operate-Transfer), used in railway projects like private sidings and terminals.
